summary:
Turn 43 fixed the binding shape and submitted the promoted-leader variant as a formal check.

What was wrong last turn. The rejected attempts failed because the monitors' own grounding objects still carried the previous plan's binding id (the divergence plan's BB2-prepare-resolution) while the plan-level lists pointed elsewhere — so the check both used a non-selected binding and left a grounding reference to an unavailable one. The successful shape, as in the earlier obligations, is to point every binding reference at the same newly supplied binding: the claim's grounding, the plan's binding_ids, each monitor's binding_ids, each monitor's grounding.binding_ids and the harness legality.

What was submitted. A new obligation C6-recovery-ignores-committed-reply-when-promoted (consensus safety, priority 3): when the replica the deployment promoted to leader (IsLeader true, with a ballot history above its ballot base) recovers an instance and a slow-quorum reply reports it COMMITTED, the recovering replica must adopt that committed vector rather than restarting phase 1 with a different command. Its scope is the promoted variant only, with the non-promoted case left to C1, and it is grounded on a new binding (BB7-leader-variant) that documents startRecoveryForInstance's raised ballot and the self VBallot it publishes. The plan carries the three properties already reviewed for the non-promoted case (adoption at the resolution, the recoverer-versus-committed-peer comparison, agreement across replicas after the Commit broadcast), with the promoted-variant semantic change and a controls note that the seed event prints is_leader, max_recv_ballot, the seed ballot and the self VBallot. The harness is the reviewed driven variant with IsLeader true and maxRecvBallot set above the ballot base.

Why it matters. The shipped aws.conf designates a leader and the master promotes through Replica.BeTheLeader, so this variant is the deployed case rather than an artificial one. The local construction run showed the same masking (new ballot 6 reported as the self VBallot, adopted_committed false, accept round completing, vectors_match false, all_committed_match false, applied state diverging), so the formal outcome is expected to be violated and awaits the trusted runner plus a fresh correspondence review. Claim C1 and the other settled claims are untouched, and no requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
